theorems.name: motor_percentage_bounded
theorems.doc: **S.** Whatever `MotorPower` arrives over the air (any `i32`), the ESC gets 0..=100 %. Upstream's `(value + 50) as u8` gives 255 % for -51.
theorems.statement:
theorem motor_percentage_bounded (v : Std.I32) :
    ∃ r, motor_percentage v = ok r ∧ r.val ≤ 100
theorems.proof:
theorem motor_percentage_bounded (v : Std.I32) :
    ∃ r, motor_percentage v = ok r ∧ r.val ≤ 100 := by
  have h : motor_percentage v ⦃ r => r.val ≤ 100 ⦄ := by
    unfold motor_percentage MOTOR_LIMIT
    step*
    have := hcast_u8_small i1 (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac)
    scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := (WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).1 h
  exact ⟨r, hr, hp⟩

theorems.name: motor_percentage_upstream_range

theorems.statement:
theorem motor_percentage_upstream_range (v : Std.I32)
    (h1 : -50 ≤ v.val) (h2 : v.val ≤ 50) :
    ∃ r, motor_percentage v = ok r ∧ (r.val : Int) = v.val + 50
theorems.proof:
theorem motor_percentage_upstream_range (v : Std.I32)

theorems.name: servo_duty_within_pulse_range
theorems.doc: **S.** The PWM duty stays within the servo's pulse range: between the duties of `min_us` and `max_us`, for the servo's constants (`min ≤ max`, `(max - min) · 100` and `max · duty_space` fit in 32 bits, a non-zero cycle; upstream's `types.rs` constants satisfy them).
theorems.statement:
theorem servo_duty_within_pulse_range (p : Std.U8) (mn mx ds cy : Std.U32)
    (h1 : mn.val ≤ mx.val) (h2 : mx.val * ds.val ≤ U32.max)
    (h4 : (mx.val - mn.val) * 100 ≤ U32.max) (h3 : 0 < cy.val) :
    ∃ r, servo_duty p mn mx ds cy = ok r ∧
      mn.val * ds.val / cy.val ≤ r.val ∧ r.val ≤ mx.val * ds.val / cy.val
theorems.proof:
theorem servo_duty_within_pulse_range (p : Std.U8) (mn mx ds cy : Std.U32)
    (h1 : mn.val ≤ mx.val) (h2 : mx.val * ds.val ≤ U32.max)
    (h4 : (mx.val - mn.val) * 100 ≤ U32.max) (h3 : 0 < cy.val) :
    ∃ r, servo_duty p mn mx ds cy = ok r ∧
      mn.val * ds.val / cy.val ≤ r.val ∧ r.val ≤ mx.val * ds.val / cy.val := by
  have h : servo_duty p mn mx ds cy ⦃ r =>
      mn.val * ds.val / cy.val ≤ r.val ∧ r.val ≤ mx.val * ds.val / cy.val ⦄ := by
    unfold servo_duty
    -- percentage is capped at 100 in both branches (`servo_math`)
    split
    · have hq : (100 : Nat) ≤ 100 := le_refl 100
      step*
      all_goals first
        | exact servo_mul_fits hq range_post h4
        | exact servo_add_fits hq h1 range_post i_post i1_post (by scalar_tac)
        | exact (servo_math (cy := cy.val) hq h1 h2 range_post i_post i1_post abs_duty_post).1
        | (rw [r_post, i2_post]; exact (servo_math hq h1 h2 range_post i_post i1_post abs_duty_post).2)
    · rename_i hp
      have hq : (UScalar.cast UScalarTy.U32 p).val ≤ 100 := by scalar_tac
      step*
      all_goals first
        | exact servo_mul_fits hq range_post h4
        | exact servo_add_fits hq h1 range_post i_post i1_post (by scalar_tac)
        | exact (servo_math (cy := cy.val) hq h1 h2 range_post i_post i1_post abs_duty_post).1
        | (rw [r_post, i2_post]; exact (servo_math hq h1 h2 range_post i_post i1_post abs_duty_post).2)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := (WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).1 h
  exact ⟨r, hr, hp⟩

theorems.name: magnitude_spec
theorems.statement:
theorem magnitude_spec (v : Std.I32) :
    ∃ r, magnitude v = ok r ∧ (r.val : Int) = v.val.natAbs
theorems.proof:
theorem magnitude_spec (v : Std.I32) :
    ∃ r, magnitude v = ok r ∧ (r.val : Int) = v.val.natAbs := by
  have h : magnitude v ⦃ r => (r.val : Int) = v.val.natAbs ⦄ := by
    unfold magnitude
    step*
    · have h := hcast_u32_nonneg i1 (by scalar_tac)
      rw [← i2_post] at h
      scalar_tac
    · have h := hcast_u32_nonneg i1 (by scalar_tac)
      rw [← i2_post] at h
      have hn := Int.ofNat_natAbs_of_nonpos (show v.val ≤ 0 by scalar_tac)
      scalar_tac
    · have h := hcast_u32_nonneg v (by scalar_tac)
      have hn := Int.natAbs_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ v.val by scalar_tac)
      scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := (WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).1 h
  exact ⟨r, hr, hp⟩

theorems.name: brake_off_after_timeout
theorems.doc: **S.** A brake light on for more than 500 ms goes off at the next tick.
theorems.statement:
theorem brake_off_after_timeout (s : Brake) (now : Std.U64)
    (hon : s.on = true) (ht : s.last_update_ms.val + 500 < now.val) :
    ∃ s', brake_on_tick s now = ok (s', true) ∧ s'.on = false
theorems.proof:
theorem brake_off_after_timeout (s : Brake) (now : Std.U64)
    (hon : s.on = true) (ht : s.last_update_ms.val + 500 < now.val) :
    ∃ s', brake_on_tick s now = ok (s', true) ∧ s'.on = false := by
  have h : brake_on_tick s now ⦃ r => r.2 = true ∧ r.1.on = false ⦄ := by
    unfold brake_on_tick BRAKELIGHT_TIMEOUT_MS
    simp only [hon, if_true]
    step*
  obtain ⟨r, hr, h1, h2⟩ := (WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).1 h
  obtain ⟨s', b⟩ := r
  simp only at h1 h2
  subst h1
  exact ⟨s', hr, h2⟩

theorems.name: brake_on_only_when_slowing
theorems.doc: **S.** The brake light comes on exactly when the motor's magnitude drops (for every `i32`, `i32::MIN` included).
theorems.statement:
theorem brake_on_only_when_slowing (s : Brake) (v : Std.I32) (now : Std.U64) :
    ∃ s', brake_on_motor s v now = ok s' ∧
      (s'.on = true ↔ v.val.natAbs < s.last_setting.val.natAbs) ∧
      s'.last_setting = v ∧ s'.last_update_ms = now
theorems.proof:
theorem brake_on_only_when_slowing (s : Brake) (v : Std.I32) (now : Std.U64) :
    ∃ s', brake_on_motor s v now = ok s' ∧
      (s'.on = true ↔ v.val.natAbs < s.last_setting.val.natAbs) ∧
      s'.last_setting = v ∧ s'.last_update_ms = now := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hav⟩ := magnitude_spec v
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hbv⟩ := magnitude_spec s.last_setting
  refine ⟨{ last_setting := v, last_update_ms := now, on := decide (a < b) },
    by unfold brake_on_motor; simp [ha, hb], ?_, rfl, rfl⟩
  simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> scalar_tac

theorems.name: blinker_command_takes_effect
theorems.doc: **S (U2 fix).** While a pattern blinks, a blinker command takes effect: the new pattern is the command (upstream kept toggling the first one).
theorems.statement:
theorem blinker_command_takes_effect (s : Blinker) (cmd : Blink)
    (h : s.pattern ≠ Blink.Off) :
    ∃ s' l, blinker_command s cmd = ok (s', l) ∧ s'.pattern = cmd
theorems.proof:
theorem blinker_command_takes_effect (s : Blinker) (cmd : Blink)
    (h : s.pattern ≠ Blink.Off) :
    ∃ s' l, blinker_command s cmd = ok (s', l) ∧ s'.pattern = cmd := by
  rcases s with ⟨p, ph⟩
  cases p <;> cases cmd <;> simp_all [blinker_command, lamps]

theorems.name: blinker_off_lamps_off
theorems.doc: **S.** `Off` always leaves the blinker idle with both lamps off (idle: the lamps are driven off; blinking: the command's lamps are off).
theorems.statement:
theorem blinker_off_lamps_off (s : Blinker) :
    ∃ s' l, blinker_command s Blink.Off = ok (s', l) ∧ s'.pattern = Blink.Off ∧
      ∀ x, l = some x → x.left = false ∧ x.right = false
theorems.proof:
theorem blinker_off_lamps_off (s : Blinker) :
    ∃ s' l, blinker_command s Blink.Off = ok (s', l) ∧ s'.pattern = Blink.Off ∧
      ∀ x, l = some x → x.left = false ∧ x.right = false := by
  rcases s with ⟨p, ph⟩
  cases p <;> simp [blinker_command, lamps]

theorems.name: blinker_tick_alternates
theorems.doc: **C.** A tick flips the phase; the lamps are off in the off phase and follow the pattern in the on phase.
theorems.statement:
theorem blinker_tick_alternates (s : Blinker) :
    ∃ s' l, blinker_tick s = ok (s', l) ∧ s'.phase = !s.phase ∧ s'.pattern = s.pattern ∧
      (s.phase = true → l.left = false ∧ l.right = false)
theorems.proof:
theorem blinker_tick_alternates (s : Blinker) :
    ∃ s' l, blinker_tick s = ok (s', l) ∧ s'.phase = !s.phase ∧ s'.pattern = s.pattern ∧
      (s.phase = true → l.left = false ∧ l.right = false) := by
  rcases s with ⟨p, ph⟩
  cases p <;> cases ph <;> simp [blinker_tick, lamps]

Brake.lean:
structure Brake where
  last_setting : Std.I32
  last_update_ms : Std.U64
  on : Bool

brake_on_motor.lean:
def brake_on_motor
  (s : Brake) (value : Std.I32) (now_ms : Std.U64) : Result Brake := do
  let i ← magnitude value
  let i1 ← magnitude s.last_setting
  ok { last_setting := value, last_update_ms := now_ms, on := (i < i1) }

Blinker.lean:
structure Blinker where
  pattern : Blink
  phase : Bool

clamp.lean:
def clamp (value : Std.I32) (limit : Std.I32) : Result Std.I32 := do
  let i ← -. limit
  if value < i
  then ok i
  else if value > limit
       then ok limit
       else ok value

magnitude.lean:
def magnitude (v : Std.I32) : Result Std.U32 := do
  if v < 0#i32
  then
    let i ← v + 1#i32
    let i1 ← -. i
    let i2 ← lift (IScalar.hcast .U32 i1)
    i2 + 1#u32
  else ok (IScalar.hcast .U32 v)

Lamps.lean:
structure Lamps where
  left : Bool
  right : Bool

motor_percentage.lean:
def motor_percentage (value : Std.I32) : Result Std.U8 := do
  let i ← clamp value MOTOR_LIMIT
  let i1 ← i + 50#i32
  ok (IScalar.hcast .U8 i1)

blinker_tick.lean:
def blinker_tick (s : Blinker) : Result (Blinker × Lamps) := do
  let l ← lamps (¬ s.phase) s.pattern
  ok ({ s with phase := (¬ s.phase) }, l)

servo_duty.lean:
def servo_duty
  (percentage : Std.U8) (min_us : Std.U32) (max_us : Std.U32)
  (duty_space : Std.U32) (cycle_us : Std.U32) :
  Result Std.U32
  := do
  let p ←
    if percentage > 100#u8
    then ok 100#u32
    else ok (UScalar.cast .U32 percentage)
  let range ← max_us - min_us
  let i ← range * p
  let i1 ← i / 100#u32
  let abs_duty ← min_us + i1
  let i2 ← abs_duty * duty_space
  i2 / cycle_us

brake_on_tick.lean:
def brake_on_tick (s : Brake) (now_ms : Std.U64) : Result (Brake × Bool) := do
  if s.on
  then
    if now_ms > s.last_update_ms
    then
      let i ← now_ms - s.last_update_ms
      if i > BRAKELIGHT_TIMEOUT_MS
      then ok ({ s with on := false }, true)
      else ok (s, false)
    else ok (s, false)
  else ok (s, false)

blinker_command.lean:
def blinker_command
  (s : Blinker) (cmd : Blink) : Result (Blinker × (Option Lamps)) := do
  match s.pattern with
  | Blink.Left =>
    let l ← lamps true cmd
    ok ({ pattern := cmd, phase := true }, some l)
  | Blink.Right =>
    let l ← lamps true cmd
    ok ({ pattern := cmd, phase := true }, some l)
  | Blink.Off =>
    match cmd with
    | Blink.Left => ok ({ s with pattern := Blink.Left }, none)
    | Blink.Right => ok ({ s with pattern := Blink.Right }, none)
    | Blink.Off => ok (s, some { left := false, right := false })
    | Blink.Alarm => ok ({ s with pattern := Blink.Alarm }, none)
  | Blink.Alarm =>
    let l ← lamps true cmd
    ok ({ pattern := cmd, phase := true }, some l)

steering_percentage.lean:
def steering_percentage (value : Std.I32) : Result Std.U8 := do
  let i ← clamp value STEER_LIMIT
  let i1 ← i + 50#i32
  ok (IScalar.hcast .U8 i1)

Blink.lean:
@[discriminant isize]
inductive Blink where
| Left : Blink
| Right : Blink
| Off : Blink
| Alarm : Blink
